messages:
Marta: Quick brainstorm: I'm drafting a small playbook for automatic fallback rollouts. Need alignment on what triggers we show and what operator actions (preview / force / rollback) do in the console.

Jon: Let's keep triggers tight: infra 5xx spikes, latency p95 breaches, model-generation aborts, and dedicated capacity exhaustion.

Amy: Agree. For capacity exhaustion we must show which pool and the fallback target (hosted or quantized variant) + rough cost delta.

Sam: UX idea: one-line rows per trigger with columns: trigger, last-fired, sample request link, and a tiny "Sim 1%" button that runs a non-destructive preview. Preview returns sim histogram + json audit sample.

Hina: Audit must be structured: trigger, metrics at firing (values), policy_id, fallback_target, operator_override (if any), operator_id, operator_note. Retention default 90d and exportable. Also add a "Why did this fallback" deeplink from route page.

Marta: Hysteresis is important to avoid oscillation. Propose policy-level knobs: cooldown_sec, min_serve_sec, max_swaps_per_min. Defaults: 60s/120s/2 swaps per min. Dedicated customers get longer min_serve_sec.

Jon: Also add a flapping detector that suppresses further automatic swaps and marks the policy for manual review if swaps exceed a threshold.

Amy: For force actions UI should show a soft-confirm modal listing impacted routes + cost delta and require a short reason. Force actions should still emit audit entries with operator_action=force_on/force_off.

Marta: Draft policy editor JSON (for the docs):

```json
{
  "policy_id": "rbx-auto-1",
  "triggers": [
    {"type":"infrastructure_5xx","window_sec":60,"threshold":5},
    {"type":"latency_p95","window_sec":300,"threshold_ms":1000}
  ],
  "degrade_mode": "fallback_variant",
  "fallback_target": "gptq-medium-v1",
  "hysteresis": {"cooldown_sec":60,"min_serve_sec":120,"max_swaps_per_min":2}
}
```

Sam: I'll wire the rollout-sandbox sim API into the modal so preview shows expected token-cost and latency delta. Keyboard shortcuts behind flag: p=preview, f=force, r=rollback.

Hina: I'll publish audit schema and retention/export endpoints. Add a field audit_sample_id so sim and real events cross-reference.

Deploy Bot: Deploy finished -> branch autofallback-playbook -> staging (sha def456).

Marta: Action items: Iuild small mock for matrix+modal, Jon add flapping detector sim tests, Amy define cost calc, Hina finalize audit schema. Back in 48h.

Amy: I'll do cost calc tomorrow.

Jon: Will add unit tests for hysteresis.

Hina: Will draft the export API doc.

Marta: Thanks all :thumbsup:
